relevant_laws.quote: A U-turn may be made on any road where the turn can be made with safety, except as prohibited by this section [NRS-484B-403-2, NRS-484B-403-3] and by the provisions of NRS 484B.227, 484B.363 and 484B.407 [NRS-484B-227-1, NRS-484B-363-3, NRS-484B-407].
